tools.name: get_conditions
tools.description: Current flow at the Bennett Spring put-in, plus stage and flood category. Flow is in cubic feet per second (cfs); stage is in feet (ft). The put-in flow is derived by adding two public gauges, and the response lists both inputs. The reaches are descriptive pages; no gauge measures them. Readings ref

tools.name: list_accesses
tools.description: Public river accesses as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Coordinates are WGS84 longitude/latitude. Each feature carries the source and verified_on date for its record; access details change rarely but are not live.

tools.name: get_businesses
tools.description: Businesses that serve the valley, filtered by category. Returns { businesses: [...] }. Hours are local time in 24-hour form and change seasonally; each record carries the source and date it was checked.

tools.name: get_regulations
tools.description: Plain-English fishing and floating rules for a water, each with a link to the official source. Not a substitute for the official text.
